# pcd_keymanager_secret (Data Source)

Look up a Barbican secret by name or reference. Exactly one secret must match. The secret's `payload` is fetched only when `payload_content_type` is set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pcd_keymanager_secret" "example" {
  name                 = "tf-example-passphrase"
  payload_content_type = "text/plain"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Look up by (and report) the secret name.
- `payload_content_type` (String) Set to fetch the payload with this content type (Accept header).
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `secret_ref` (String) Look up by secret reference (URL or UUID); takes precedence over name.

### Read-Only

- `algorithm` (String) The encryption algorithm.
- `bit_length` (Number) The bit length.
- `content_types` (Map of String) The content types the secret is available in.
- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `creator_id` (String) The ID of the user that created the secret.
- `expiration` (String) The expiration timestamp (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) The secret UUID.
- `mode` (String) The cipher mode.
- `payload` (String, Sensitive) The secret payload, populated only when payload_content_type is set.
- `secret_type` (String) The secret type.
- `status` (String) The secret status.
